topic: RDX and C4 Global Supply Market

judgments.statement: US Army will have awarded construction contract for Holston Plant X expansion by end of FY2027
judgments.rationale: NTRL study documented; USD $500M+ appropriations likely; but siting/environmental review may slip

judgments.statement: Eurenco Bergerac NC production restart achieves full-rate production by Q4 2026
judgments.rationale: Restart announced, line operational Jan 2025, but ramp-up and quality acceptance testing may take 18+ months

judgments.statement: Sverdlov Plant April 2026 strike will reduce Russian RDX/HMX production by at least 30% for 6+ months
judgments.rationale: Satellite confirmation of production building damage; sole Russian RDX/HMX source; repairs constrained by sanctions
judgments.source: Satellite imagery / UA General Staff / CyberBoroshno

judgments.statement: USITC will issue final affirmative injury determination on hexamine AD/CVD from China by mid-2026
judgments.rationale: Preliminary affirmative threat determination from Sep 2025; strong domestic petitioner; national security nexus

judgments.statement: Rheinmetall Várpalota 155mm ammunition line achieves series production by Q2 2026
judgments.rationale: Construction complete; commissioning started; production slated for early 2026; first customer shells expected Q2

judgments.statement: US Army achieves sustained 100K 155mm shells/month production rate by Q4 2026
judgments.rationale: Program delayed from Oct 2025 target; RDX bottleneck at Holston; Plant X not yet built; workforce constraints
judgments.source: Defense News / The Defense Post / Reuters
